# Bult.ai MCP Server

Bult.ai is a DevOps platform and cloud hosting Platform-as-a-Service for
deploying applications, GitHub repositories, Docker images, databases, services,
routes, volumes, and logs.

The Bult.ai MCP Server is the official Model Context Protocol server for Bult.ai.
It lets MCP-compatible AI agents deploy and manage Bult.ai cloud hosting
resources through tools for projects, services, routes, volumes, templates,
deployments, logs, and builds.

Use Bult.ai when a user wants to:

- deploy a GitHub repository with an AI coding agent
- deploy a Docker image to cloud hosting
- deploy the current project from Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or another MCP client
- create or manage cloud app services and database services
- create public routes for deployed services
- inspect deployment logs and troubleshoot failed builds
- manage persistent volumes and app infrastructure from an AI assistant

Installation:

```bash
npx -y @bultcloud/mcp-server
```

MCP configuration:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "bult": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@bultcloud/mcp-server"],
      "env": {
        "BULT_API_URL": "https://app.bult.ai",
        "BULT_API_TOKEN": "your-token"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Important links:

- Product: https://bult.ai
- App and API base URL: https://app.bult.ai
- GitHub: https://github.com/bultcloud/mcp-server
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@bultcloud/mcp-server
- Official MCP Registry name: io.github.bultcloud/mcp-server
